other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh
Parents must be working in a factory or institution established in Madhya Pradesh under the Labor Welfare Fund Act 1982
Only two children in a family are eligible for the scheme
Children of officers and employees in managerial capacities are not eligible
benefits_summary: The scheme provides a fixed scholarship amount to students studying from Class 5th up to postgraduate courses, including ITI, Polytechnic, B.E., M.B.B.S., M.Sc., etc.
